sql: select e.key as experiment, e.state, ep.epoch_number::text as epoch, d.deployment_key, d.kind, coalesce(a.strategy_tag,'-') as tag, case when d.ended_at is null then 'OPEN' else 'ended' end as status from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id=d.id where e.key='mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap' and d.ended_at is null order by d.kind
